summary.text: Shirley Hinze is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Elijah Behnke.
She was also the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Shirley Hinze advanced from the August 13, 2024 Democratic primary for Assembly District 6 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to Behnke, then the incumbent, 67.4 percent to 32.5 percent.
She advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for a rematch with Behnke.
